sasha: Quick sync — planning v2.15 release. Need to lock cutoff windows for US/EU/APAC. Proposed cutoffs (UTC):
- EU: Fri 08:15 UTC (freeze)
- US: Fri 17:00 UTC
- APAC: Sat 02:00 UTC
Can everyone confirm these don't conflict with migrations and canary timing? @jamie @kevin :clock1:

jamie: EU migration needs ~2h prep, prefer 08:30 UTC for the migration start. If we move EU cutoff earlier to 08:15 that's fine. Also reminder: bump version to `2.15.0-rc1` in the release branch.

kevin: API compatibility check is green. Bumping minor looks safe. I'll open the PR to update `package.json` + changelog. Plan to schedule US canary ~1h after US cutoff.

maria: FYI support asked for a short changelog blurb about endpoint quota behavior. I can draft the blurb and add it to the changelog PR.

sasha: Good. jamie, can you confirm the DB migration window 08:30-10:30 UTC? If so I'll move EU cutoff to 08:15 to give us a buffer.

jamie: Confirmed. Migration window 08:30-10:30, runbook steps: `./scripts/mig-run --dry-run` then `./scripts/mig-run --apply`. Notify oncall before `--apply`.

oncall-robin: I'll be available. Please @me 30m before migration start, and include the rollback checklist in the PR (schema rollback, service-disable flag).

kevin: Opening PR now: `bump/2.15.0` with changelog draft and package bump. PTAL @sasha @maria — aiming to merge by EOD so CI can finish before cutoffs.

deploy-bot: Canary job scheduled: region=us, start=1797730800 (UTC), duration=30m. Canary will run traffic through primary pool and run smoke checks. Report will be posted to this thread.

sasha: Final plan summary (canonical):
- EU cutoff: Fri 08:15 UTC (migration 08:30-10:30) — jamie runs migration
- US cutoff: Fri 17:00 UTC (canary ~18:00 UTC)
- APAC cutoff: Sat 02:00 UTC
I'll update the release calendar and ping #support with changelog blurb. If anyone has blockers, reply here by EOD. :white_check_mark:

kevin: Code review ping sent to @jamie @maria, two small nits left. Will re-run CI after fixes.

maria: Draft changelog (short): "Added endpoint-level quota controls; behavior changes for burst requests; upgrade to 2.15.0." Pasting into PR now.

jamie: LGTM on changelog. One minor doc tweak in the runbook, will open a tiny PR against `bump/2.15.0`.

sasha: Thanks all — tagging this as the release plan. I'll post the calendar invite with UTC times and add a short checklist to the release PR. :rocket:
